name: Mercenary Fanatic Zeal
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of Fanatic Zeal (players/witch_hunter/mercenary/fanatic_zeal_merc.sval, 17 skill points in the Mercenary skill shop). Against HoH1 level 5 (in brackets): 2% per stack (2.5%); max 10 (8); 5 s (8 s). Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon. Numbers are HoH1's, not this port's.
summary: Casting a skill gives a Zeal stack: 2% crit chance each, up to 10 stacks of 5 s.
